LanguageData.TurboTick_Prototype: Independent multiplayer protocol prototype: dedicated connection, speed settings sync and snapshot cache. Shared-colony, pawn and building command replication are still in development.
LanguageData.TurboTick_EnableDesc: In a room, enabled state, multiplier and cap require server confirmation together. Single-player preferences stay local.
LanguageData.TurboTick_ShowHudDesc: Actual completed TPS, target TPS, connection holds and server policy revision.
LanguageData.TurboTick_Held: Connection pending / lost: simulation held. Reconnect or leave the room in settings.
LanguageData.TurboTick_RoomPrototype: Room speed settings connected; shared-colony replication in development.
LanguageData.TurboTick_Local: Not in a room / local mode
LanguageData.TurboTick_LowTps: Below target TPS. Adjust the speed through the user or server.
